reviewer: Antigravity Creative Studio Agent (Apple Silicon M2 / Session Guard)

criteria.question: One clear focal point per beat; reading order is obvious.
criteria.notes: Every beat pairs a high-contrast kicker and title with a dominant hero element: spline surge/plunge in S1, mechanical radial liquidation gauge with rotating needle in S2, retail volume meter and particle bottleneck in S3, and -$2.4T monument takeaway in S4.

criteria.question: Type roles are consistent; sizes respect the floor; no orphans or awkward breaks.
criteria.notes: Playfair Display serif for titles (40px), JetBrains Mono for kickers (20px) and live counters (36px/46px/92px), Inter for body and subtitles (20-22px). Readability floor strictly respected.

criteria.question: Layouts are intentional in every format (not stretched or cropped landscape).
criteria.notes: Purpose-built 720x1280 portrait 9:16 layout with top progress bar, 570px hero stages (>68% stage occupancy), and permanently anchored bottom takeaway cards eliminating empty space.

criteria.question: Holds match reading time; rhythm varies; nothing drags or rushes.
criteria.notes: Choreographed directly to measured speech timestamps in timeline.json. Multi-beat scene structure introduces new visual developments every 2.0-2.5 seconds.

criteria.question: All text is legible at delivery size with sufficient contrast.
criteria.notes: Passes WCAG AA contrast (15.4:1 contrast ratio of charcoal #111827 on warm ivory #FBFBFA canvas). 0 linter errors across all frames.

criteria.question: Palette and texture follow the chosen style system and direction.
criteria.notes: Follows editorial-light system: warm ivory canvas (#FBFBFA), deep vermilion/terracotta (#DC2626), marigold amber (#D97706), electric ultramarine (#1D4ED8), and charcoal (#111827).

criteria.question: Each transition carries meaning or continuity; none are decorative filler.
criteria.notes: Employs composable spatial transitions (push up, push left, wipe) connecting crash momentum to liquidation unwind and retail bottleneck.

criteria.question: Motion vocabulary is consistent across scenes.
criteria.notes: Harmonious visual language combining Catmull-Rom spline curves, mechanical dials with needle deflection, streaming particles, and bold financial typography.

criteria.question: No repetitive looping filler or motion without purpose.
criteria.notes: Every movement advances explanation: spline traces price plunge, gauge drains equity collateral, particles visualize order congestion, strikethrough invalidates state rescue.

criteria.question: No unintended static stretches; intentional holds are marked.
criteria.notes: Continuous virtual camera drift (1.0 -> 1.035) and rapid micro-beats eliminate static visual freezes. Final takeaway holds cleanly for 5.0s.

criteria.question: No accidental overlaps, clipping or safe-area violations.
criteria.notes: Zero layout collisions or clipping across all scenes. All text remains within safe margins.

criteria.question: Clear opening, progression and ending; the last frame holds long enough.
criteria.notes: Complete dramatic arc: Bubble Euphoria -> Margin Trap -> Herd Contagion -> Broken Intervention & Monument Loss (-$2.4T). Final frame holds for 5.0 seconds.

pass_rule: Every criterion scored 1-5 with evidence (frame or contact-sheet paths); all >= 3 and mean >= 3.5.
